card_sentences: SAMPLE A butcher and a chef in the Bronx make these from turkey raised in upstate New York. They wanted a meat stick that tastes like real food.

may_contain_verbatim: SAMPLE PRODUCED IN A FACILITY THAT ALSO HANDLES PEANUTS, TREE NUTS, FISH AND SHELLFISH.
